Class PreparePaymentSubmissionService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.application.usecase.PreparePaymentSubmissionService
public final class PreparePaymentSubmissionService extends Object
Prepare exactly once within the submit that authorized and created the intent. Never reserves or dispatches.

      wallets - wallet resolution use case

      gate - settlement authorization gate

  • Method Details

    • prepare

      public PreparedPaymentSubmission prepare(PreparePaymentSubmissionCommand command)
      Validates and locks the intent, resolves wallets and fees, hashes and gates the proposal, then records VALIDATING and QUORUM_SYNC transitions. It deliberately performs no reserve or external dispatch; those are later steps in the same owning submission transaction.
      Parameters:
      command - normalized values and authorization context for the locked intent
      Returns:
      prepared submission snapshot and resolved destination
